item.text: The ACT Integrity Commission assessed complaints referred by the Suburban Land Agency about residential land sale processes in Throsby and Whitlam.
item.support: The triggering complaints concerned the “book-to-buy” release process for residential lots in Throsby

item.text: It concluded that the complaints did not justify investigation, while identifying corruption risks in the sale process.
item.support: no reasonable suspicion of corruption arises, examination of the issues raised by the complaints has identified several significant matters

item.text: The Commission considered that undisclosed principals using several agents could undermine limits on purchases.
item.support: any number of registrants could be acting as agents for a third party

item.text: It recommended reconsidering the sales conditions and suggested requiring applicants to disclose agency arrangements and confirm they had not made multiple applications.
item.support: The Commission recommended that should be reconsidered by the ACT Government Solicitor
